<div class="card-body">
'''Tusken Scavengers''' is a [[Dark]] [[Interrupt]] from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">タスケンの略奪</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">１フォース消費して運命数を引く。運命数＜（場にいるタスケン・レイダーの人数）であれば、相手のユーズドデッキをあさる（カードを探す）こと。そこにあったすべてのビークル、武器、アイテムはロストする。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-275o-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">「サンド・ピープルは人数を隠すため、バンサに乗る時は一列に進む。」しばしば、よそものを襲って装備を奪い、ルークのランドスピーダーも略奪にあった。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Tusken Raiding.

'''Card text:''' Use 1 Force and draw destiny. If it is less than the number of Tusken Raiders on table, search your opponent's Used Pile. All vehicles, weapons, and items found there are lost.

'''Lore:''' “Sand People ride their banthas in single file to hide their numbers.” They often attack outsiders for their equipment, and Luke's landspeeder was raided as well.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Tusken Scavengers]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 97. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
